scope: Selected upstream files; the retained root manifest has absent workspace members pruned, and a tree-local rustfmt configuration disables host formatting. Unselected producer applications are not dependencies.
nonclaims: This local immutable import is not remote publication, source authority, source trust, or release eligibility. A source checkout is needed only to reproduce the import, never to build Kiln.
manifest_normalization: Absent workspace members are pruned from the retained root manifest so Cargo can read the partial import without resolving unselected upstream producers.
formatter_scope: Tree-local rustfmt configuration sets disable_all_formatting so the host workspace formatter covers Kiln-owned sources without rewriting pinned upstream bytes.
